items.title: Azure AI Gateway Reaches General Availability as a Standalone Service
items.summaryShort: Azure AI Gateway Reaches General Availability as a Standalone Service. Microsoft has made Azure AI Gateway generally available as a standalone Azure service for governing access to AI models and MCP tools across providers.

items.title: Meta Brings Code Review Auto-Approval More Mainstream with PyTorch GreenLight
items.summaryShort: Meta Brings Code Review Auto-Approval More Mainstream with PyTorch GreenLight. PyTorch now lets an AI reviewer approve pull requests from its own maintainers.

items.title: Netflix Builds Quasar to Measure the Blast Radius of Library API Changes
items.summaryShort: Netflix Builds Quasar to Measure the Blast Radius of Library API Changes. Netflix developed Quasar, an internal tool that combines semantic code indexing and API comparisons to identify downstream consumers affected by library changes.

items.summaryShort: Presentation: From Fan-Out to Fast: Sub-100ms API Design in Distributed Systems. Saranya Vedagiri explains how to design resilient, low-latency distributed APIs under 100ms.

items.title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not?
items.summaryShort: Is Alice Huang a spy or not?. The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed exec with whom Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair, is a Chinese spy.

items.title: X finally gets parental controls after 20 years
items.summaryShort: X finally gets parental controls after 20 years. Elon Musk's social network X has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see on the platform.
